p.i: Carpit,& in medijs nauta quiescit aquis:
Noĉe leues somnos carpit desessus arator,
Noĉe quies ventis, Ioniòque mari:
Noĉe tibi nigra fuligo bibenda lucerna,
Si modò Callispes castra sequenda putes:

main_text.p: Et tanquam Libyco serues curuata metallo · ·

p.i: Robora, & Herculea poma ferenda manu,
Peruigil in lucem lecta atque rselecta reuolues,
Et putri excuties scripta sepulta situ.
Sape caput scalpes, & viuos roseris vngues,
Irata ferries pulpita sape manu.
Hinc subita mortes, & spes prærepta senetta,
Nec tibi fert Clio, nec tibi Phœbus opem.
Si caput in cubitum lassa ceruice recumbat,
Et sopor exiguus lumina sessa premat:
Ecce, vigil subitò quartam denunciat horam,
Et tonitru horrifico lumina clausa quatit.
Excutit attonito somnos sonus æris acuti,
Admonet & molli membra leuare toro.
Vix siluit, iam quinta sonat: iam ianitor vrget
Cymbala, tirones ad sua signa vocans.
Mox sequitur longa metuendus veste magister,
Et humero læuo mantica terga premit.
Dextera crudelis in pueros armata flagello est:
Lœuâ tenet magni forte Maronis opus.
Iam sedet, & longis clamoribus illa rumpit,
Excutit implicitos ingenióque locos.
Corrigit, & delet, mutat, vigilata labore
Promit, in obscuro quæ latuere diu.
Magna nec ingeniis aut explorata priorîs
Eruit, inuentas nec sibi celat opes.
Alter abest, petiitúrque alter, mercede parato

page.notes: The page has a few small marks in the left margin (edge of the neighbouring page), not transcribed. Several words in the verse are doubtful in the scan, notably "rselecta", "Noĉe" and "sessa"; these are copied as they appear. Some lines are partly faded at the right edge.
